name: Mark as breeder
duplicates: built inside Inspection — see inspection / health-record

notes.purpose: Zero fields: the drawer is the confirmation.
rules: For an all-tagged selection the sheet opens directly: no extra steps.
The body line states the visible consequence: they appear in the breeding-stock list.

notes.purpose: The pigs that cannot be marked are listed with the reason.

elements.name: Left-out line
elements.shows: Amber line with the count and the reason
elements.rule: The primary acts on the remainder, with the count in the verb. The chevron opens the left-out rows; nobody is dropped in silence.
elements.logic: Which pigs are blocked depends on the eligibility predicate, which production never states (open); the reason line is where those answers land.

notes.purpose: The second verb, not a toggle.
rules: Same drawer shape as Mark with the count in the primary ("Remove breeding mark from 6").
No identity gate: a marked pig has a tag by definition. The footnote says the pigs leave the list and the trail stays.

notes.purpose: The marked pigs as a set, not a row token.
rules: The funnel's marked-set filter collects them for a bulk Transfer (for example to gilt development).
The durable fact sits on her page under Identity; modify and Unmark are reached there at one pig.
